scope: Complete official Square OpenAPI inventory from https://developer.squareup.com/api/devs-content/content/open-api-3/latest; latest Square-Version list entry 2026-07-15. Live provider calls, credentials, OAuth token lifecycle, generic batch passthrough, CDC/webhook lifecycle, deprecated operations, and binary/multipart file transfer are not executed in this fixture-only parity slice.
